        raise TypeError("id must be a string or an integer")
    return key

    require_record(current)
    require_record(candidate)

"""Field helpers for record completion."""

DEFAULT_VERSION = 1
DEFAULT_SOURCE = "unknown"


def require_record(record, name="record"):
    """Return record after checking that it is a mapping."""
    if not isinstance(record, dict):
        raise TypeError(f"{name} must be a dictionary")
    return record


def fill_missing(record):
    """Return a copy of record with default fields applied."""
    require_record(record)
    filled = dict(record)
    filled.setdefault("version", DEFAULT_VERSION)
    filled.setdefault("source", DEFAULT_SOURCE)
    return filled

import pytest

from mergekit import (
    complete_record,
    conflicting_fields,
    describe_conflicts,
    field_names,
    fill_missing,
    format_merge,
    format_records,
    group_by_id,
    has_conflict,
    latest_versions,
    merge_field,
    merge_records,
    pick_latest,
    record_key,
    reorder,
    shared_fields,
    sort_by_version,
    stable_order,
    summarize_fields,
    summarize_versions,
    unique_ids,
)


def test_fill_missing_applies_defaults_without_mutation():
    record = {"id": "a", "name": "ana"}
    filled = fill_missing(record)
    assert filled == {"id": "a", "name": "ana", "version": 1, "source": "unknown"}
    assert record == {"id": "a", "name": "ana"}


def test_complete_record():
    record = {"id": "a", "version": 2}
    defaults = {"id": "x", "name": "default", "version": 1}
    assert complete_record(record, defaults) == {
        "id": "a",
        "name": "default",
        "version": 2,
        "source": "unknown",
    }


def test_field_helpers():
    records = [{"id": "a", "name": "ana"}, {"id": "b", "score": 3}]
    assert field_names(records) == ["id", "name", "score"]
    assert shared_fields(records) == ["id"]
    assert shared_fields([]) == []


def test_record_key():
    assert record_key({"id": "a"}) == "a"
    assert record_key({"id": 3}) == 3
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        record_key({"name": "ana"})
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        record_key({"id": 3.5})


def test_group_by_id():
    records = [{"id": "a"}, {"id": "b"}, {"id": "a"}]
    groups = group_by_id(records)
    assert list(groups) == ["a", "b"]
    assert len(groups["a"]) == 2


def test_merge_records_with_unique_ids():
    records = [
        {"id": "b", "version": 1},
        {"id": "a", "version": 2},
    ]
    merged = merge_records(records)
